name: Get Found
tagline: Rank in Google — and get named in the AI answers.
rationale: Getting found is no longer one channel. You have to rank in Google and get named when someone asks an AI. This bundle runs the whole loop: research what people are actually saying, turn the gaps into briefs, keep the site technically clean, watch where rivals and the AI answers put you, and make the final copy read like a human wrote it. Start with Index for the briefs and add the rest as each gap shows up.

members.name: Index (SEO/AEO Teammate)
members.reason: Reads what you've already connected and turns the gaps into content briefs your writers can actually run with.

members.name: AIO Specialist (AEO/GEO)
members.reason: Runs answer-engine and generative-engine optimisation as an ongoing program, not a one-off check of what a chatbot says today.

members.name: Scout (Competitive Intelligence)
members.reason: Watches rival sites, your search rank and whether the AI answers mention you, and flags only the moves that need a response.

members.name: Site Audit
members.reason: One pass across SEO, speed, accessibility, CRO and schema, scored P0/P1/P2 with an evidence URL on every finding.

members.name: last30days
members.reason: A social-listening sweep bounded to a month, so your angle starts from what people are saying now.

members.name: Human Copywriter
members.reason: Rewrites the AI-sounding draft into copy that reads like a person, so the pages you publish don't get marked as slop.
